column1: # Sources: 'Beef Profit from Pasture Group: Technical Summary 2' (2017) and
# 'Grazing rotation length on kikuyu grass pastures in autumn and winter'.
# Region: Northland - NOT one of the three target regions, but kikuyu is the
# dominant pasture species on lowland West Auckland lifestyle blocks, so this
# is a real, species-matched shape-proxy candidate for West_Auckland - a
# meaningfully better-reasoned proxy than the fabricated 'Waikato dairy Ruakura
# curve' it would replace (different species entirely: ryegrass/clover vs
# kikuyu, which has a markedly different, more summer-active growth pattern).
# Still a proxy: different region (Northland, not Auckland), not yet adopted.
